A tier-1 European operator — Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a 21-person team over 14 months, EU scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Retention offers fired monthly on campaign calendars; intent signals ignored in-quarter.
Network telemetry underused; NOC reactive to customer complaints.
Voice care deflected without resolving; cost per contact climbing.

blocks.x: The save hub on Nexus triggers personalized offers from support tickets, usage drops and billing disputes within policy; the telemetry backbone on Forge unified probes, elements and tickets for predictive ops; and resolution-first voice AI grounded on the policy corpus now resolves top intents with context-preserving escalation.
The engagement was structured for transfer: named pod, documented runbooks, operator enablement, and a Compound phase that keeps challenger programs and conformance monitoring running after handover.

items: Fresh waste down 28%, OOS down 31% — day-part demand and ordering agents
Fault-to-fix down 63% and street-light energy down 22% — urban asset platform

blocks.x: Towers: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Applied AI & Generative AI. Platforms: KYC Management System, EEMS Platform, Fleet Management System.

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
the baseline numbers and the client's specific regulatory posture — your program starts with its own locked baseline.
